mechanism.name: conditional Walsh-coset source-interaction stratification
mechanism.source_decomposition: X_j=|G_j| S_j with iid half-normal magnitudes and iid Rademacher source signs
mechanism.candidate: for each shared magnitude vector, average four full-network evaluations over a random Walsh coset in GF(2)^2
mechanism.cross_source_law: for differently labelled source coordinates i,j, the four-row orbit has exact average h(i)h(j)=0; same-label pairs have average 1
mechanism.late_relu_handling: every joint sign configuration is propagated through the actual complete ReLU network; no hidden-layer marginal closure or re-Gaussianization
